content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Software stripe

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a set of tools and technologies that enable digital creators to build and deploy their own online stores, without relying on third-party platforms. This infrastructure is built on open-source technologies, such as GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers, and provides creators with full control over their store's design, functionality, and payment processing. By using sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can avoid the restrictions and fees associated with traditional payment processors, and instead, focus on building their business and connecting with their customers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-6|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] of sovereign commerce infrastructure is based on a combination of open-source technologies and cloud services. For example, GitHub Pages provides a free and scalable hosting solution, while Cloudflare Workers enables creators to add custom functionality to their store, such as payment processing and inventory management. Additionally, services like Supabase and Google Sheets provide a secure and reliable way to store and manage order data, while NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment verification, with a low fee of 0.5%.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is built for digital creators who are looking for a reliable and flexible way to sell their products online, without relying on third-party platforms. This includes creators who are based in countries where Stripe and PayPal are restricted, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya. By using sovereign commerce infrastructure, these creators can build and deploy their own online stores, and connect with customers globally, without being limited by platform restrictions.
Build your own online store with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make sovereign commerce infrastructure work together include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages, backend logic tools like Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script, and order storage solutions like Supabase and Google Sheets. Additionally, payment processing services like NOWPayments enable automatic crypto payment verification, while services like Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 provide a secure and reliable way to deliver digital products to customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure today, creators can start by selecting a hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and then add custom functionality using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Next, they can set up an order storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, and integrate a payment processing service, like NOWPayments. Finally, they can deliver their digital products to customers using services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and start selling their products online, without relying on third-party platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid platform restrictions and fees with a custom solution.
